_note: Which sub-project a ledger row belongs to (CHARTER.md). Derived from the EXP directory the row is attributed to: first the report bench/audit_measurements.py attributes it to, then an EXP id in the row's `command`, then an `expNNN` id prefix. No source -> `unattributed`; never guessed. EXP-023 is a twin slot (two directories), so directories are matched by name, not by number.

values.unattributed: no source report, command or id names an experiment

exp_dirs.hw-lanes_rule: every other results/EXP-* directory: EXP-020, EXP-021, EXP-022, EXP-023-m5max-energy and EXP-024 onward
